launch_settlementSwitch11.en: Claimable is 0: the next unlock hasn't arrived, or everything was claimed. No transaction was submitted. Come back after the next unlock.
launch_settlementSwitch11.zh: 当前可领取为 0：还没到下一次释放，或已经全部领取。没有提交任何交易，下一次释放后再来。

launch_settlementSwitch12.en: This wallet's USD1 has been fully refunded. No transaction was submitted.
launch_settlementSwitch12.zh: 这个钱包的 USD1 已经全部退回，没有提交任何交易。

launch_settlementSwitch13.en: "My participation" is what counts for the allocation
launch_settlementSwitch13.zh: 份额以「我的参与记录」为准

launch_settlementSwitch7.en: The contract hasn't opened claims yet (TGE not reached, or the liquidity pool isn't live). No transaction was submitted. Details were reloaded; the claim button appears here once it opens.
launch_settlementSwitch7.zh: 合约还没有开放领取（未到 TGE，或流动性池还没有上线），没有提交任何交易。已重新读取详情，开放后这里会出现领取按钮。

launch_settlementSwitch8.en: Refunds are only possible when the sale failed or was cancelled and the refund window is open. No transaction was submitted. Details were reloaded.
launch_settlementSwitch8.zh: 只有销售失败或被取消、且退款窗口开放时才能退款，没有提交任何交易。已重新读取详情。

launch_settlementSwitch9.en: Claims and refunds are refused while the contract is paused. No transaction was submitted. Try again later.
launch_settlementSwitch9.zh: 合约暂停期间领取与退款都会被拒绝，没有提交任何交易。请稍后再试。

launch_settlementTitle2.en: Not on chain, you can start again

launch_signingClaim.en: Claim {launchUnitsFigure} tokens to the current wallet
launch_signingClaim.zh: 领取 {launchUnitsFigure} 代币到当前钱包

launch_signingClaimRefund.en: Refund {launchUnitsFigure} USD1 to the current wallet
launch_signingClaimRefund.zh: 退回 {launchUnitsFigure} USD1 到当前钱包

launch_signingIf.en: The wallet's result is unknown and this {noun} is locked. Check "My participation" and don't sign again.
launch_signingIf.zh: 钱包的结果未知，这笔{noun}已锁定。请在「我的参与记录」查看，不要重复签名。

launch_signingIf2.en: The wallet broadcast ({short}) and the server recorded it. Current status: {label}. Broadcast doesn't mean {kind}; the on-chain index decides, and it will appear in "My participation". Don't repeat the {noun}.
launch_signingIf2.zh: 钱包已广播（{short}），服务端已记录，当前状态：{label}。广播不代表{kind}，结果以链上索引为准，会出现在「我的参与记录」。不要重复{noun}。

launch_signingIf3.en: The wallet broadcast ({short}). Broadcast doesn't mean {kind}. {launchReportReasonTextFor}

launch_signingLaunchSettlementCustodyNot.en: Executed by the contract; LOOP never holds the funds
launch_signingLaunchSettlementCustodyNot.zh: 合约执行，LOOP 不经手资金

launch_signingSwitch.zh: 已取消，没有发生任何变化。

launch_signingSwitch10.en: Simulation failed: this purchase would be refused on chain. No transaction was submitted. Adjust the amount or get a new quote later.
launch_signingSwitch10.zh: 试算没有通过，这笔认购在链上会被拒绝。没有提交任何交易，请调整金额或稍后重新报价。

launch_signingSwitch11.en: This purchase can't be simulated right now, so the server doesn't allow signing. No transaction was submitted. Get a new quote later.
launch_signingSwitch11.zh: 暂时无法试算这笔认购，服务端不允许签名，没有提交任何交易。请稍后重新报价。

launch_signingSwitch12.en: This purchase was already submitted and can't be signed again. Check "My participation".
launch_signingSwitch12.zh: 这笔认购已经提交过，不能再次签名。请在「我的参与记录」查看。

launch_signingSwitch13.en: The wallet didn't finish signing. No transaction was submitted.
launch_signingSwitch13.zh: 钱包没有完成签名，没有提交任何交易。

launch_signingSwitch14.en: The signing window for this {noun} has passed. No transaction was submitted. Start again.
launch_signingSwitch14.zh: 这份{noun}的签名窗口已过，没有提交任何交易。请重新发起。

launch_signingSwitch15.en: Simulation failed: this {noun} would be refused on chain. No transaction was submitted. Refresh and try again.
launch_signingSwitch15.zh: 试算没有通过，这笔{noun}在链上会被拒绝。没有提交任何交易，请刷新后再试。

launch_signingSwitch16.en: This {noun} can't be simulated right now, so the server doesn't allow signing. No transaction was submitted. Start again later.
launch_signingSwitch16.zh: 暂时无法试算这笔{noun}，服务端不允许签名，没有提交任何交易。请稍后重新发起。

launch_signingSwitch17.en: This {noun} was already submitted and can't be signed again. Check "My participation".
launch_signingSwitch17.zh: 这笔{noun}已经提交过，不能再次签名。请在「我的参与记录」查看。

launch_signingSwitch18.en: Another transaction was already reported for this purchase, so this broadcast wasn't recorded. The transaction may be on chain; check "My participation" and don't sign again.
launch_signingSwitch18.zh: 这笔认购已经上报过另一笔交易，本次广播没有被记录。交易可能已经上链，请在「我的参与记录」核对，不要重复签名。

launch_signingSwitch19.en: The server no longer accepts reports for this purchase; its status has changed. The wallet already broadcast and the transaction may be on chain; check "My participation" and don't sign again.
launch_signingSwitch19.zh: 服务端已不再接受这笔认购的上报，它的状态已经变化。钱包已经广播，交易可能已经上链，请在「我的参与记录」核对，不要重复签名。

launch_signingSwitch2.zh: 身份验证没有通过，没有发生任何变化。

launch_signingSwitch20.en: This purchase expired and the transaction isn't visible on chain yet, so the report wasn't accepted. It may still be propagating; check "My participation" later and don't sign again.
launch_signingSwitch20.zh: 这笔认购已过期，而链上暂时还看不到这笔交易，上报没有被接受。交易可能仍在传播，请稍后在「我的参与记录」核对，不要重复签名。

launch_signingSwitch21.en: The on-chain transaction doesn't match the purchase reviewed at signing, so the server didn't record it. Check "My participation", don't sign again, and contact support.
launch_signingSwitch21.zh: 链上这笔交易与签名时复核的认购内容不一致，服务端没有记录它。请在「我的参与记录」核对，不要重复签名，并联系支持。

launch_signingSwitch22.en: The wallet already broadcast, but the server didn't accept or didn't receive this report. The transaction may be on chain; you can report again later. Don't sign again.
launch_signingSwitch22.zh: 钱包已经广播，但这次上报没有被服务端接受或没有送达。交易可能已经上链，可以稍后重新上报；不要重复签名。

launch_signingSwitch3.en: This purchase expired. No transaction was submitted. Get a new quote.
launch_signingSwitch3.zh: 这份认购已过期，没有提交任何交易。请重新获取报价。

launch_signingSwitch4.en: The transaction doesn't match what was reviewed. Signing refused; no transaction was submitted.
launch_signingSwitch4.zh: 交易内容与复核内容不一致，已拒绝签名，没有提交任何交易。

launch_signingSwitch5.en: The payment wallet for this purchase isn't in the wallet list. No transaction was submitted.
launch_signingSwitch5.zh: 钱包目录里找不到这笔认购的支付钱包，没有提交任何交易。

launch_signingSwitch6.en: Signing isn't allowed on this chain. No transaction was submitted.
launch_signingSwitch6.zh: 这条链不允许签名，没有提交任何交易。

launch_signingSwitch7.en: The wallet can't sign on this chain right now. No transaction was submitted.
launch_signingSwitch7.zh: 钱包暂时不能在这条链上签名，没有提交任何交易。

launch_signingSwitch8.en: The signed-in wallet isn't the payment wallet for this purchase. No transaction was submitted.
launch_signingSwitch8.zh: 当前登录的钱包不是这笔认购的支付钱包，没有提交任何交易。

launch_signingSwitch9.en: The wallet the server built the transaction for doesn't match the current payment wallet. Signing refused; no transaction was submitted.
launch_signingSwitch9.zh: 服务端构造交易用的钱包与当前支付钱包不一致，已拒绝签名，没有提交任何交易。

launch_tradeBody.en: No on-chain result yet. You can check again later.
launch_tradeBody.zh: 还没有读到链上结果，可以稍后重新查询。

launch_tradeBody2.en: Loading this wallet's USD1 allowance on the Launch chain. You can't buy until it loads.
launch_tradeBody2.zh: 正在读取这个钱包在 Launch 链上的 USD1 授权额度，读到之前不能购买。

launch_tradeBody3.en: {usd1}This purchase needs {amount} USD1. The approval covers only this amount, not unlimited; you can buy once it lands.
launch_tradeBody3.zh: {usd1}本次需要 {amount} USD1。授权额度只按本次金额，不是无限额度；授权到账后才能购买。

launch_tradeBody4.en: {fact}. After sending funds, reload the balance and buy again.
launch_tradeBody4.zh: {fact}。转入后重新读取余额，再重新买入。

launch_tradeCaption.en: Pay, receive, fees and remaining allowance get a final review before signing. A server quote exists only after submitting.
launch_tradeCaption.zh: 支付、获得、费用与剩余额度在签名前完成最终复核。提交后才有服务端报价。

launch_tradeCaption2.en: Quote from contract readings at block {snapshotBlockNumber}. The review below applies before signing.
launch_tradeCaption2.zh: 报价来自区块 {snapshotBlockNumber} 的合约读数，签名前以下方复核为准。

launch_tradeEmptyMessage.en: This Launch has no readable purchase info
launch_tradeEmptyMessage.zh: 这个 Launch 没有可读的认购信息

launch_tradeIf2.en: {round}This purchase is locked; don't sign again. The result will appear in "My participation".
launch_tradeIf2.zh: {round}这笔认购已锁定，不要重复签名。结果会出现在「我的参与记录」。

launch_tradeInsufficient.en: The USD1 allowance is too low. Approve this amount first, then buy once it lands.
launch_tradeInsufficient.zh: USD1 授权额度不足，需要先授权本次金额，授权到账后才能购买。

launch_tradeLaunchTradeApproveSemanticLa.en: Approve USD1 first, not available right now
launch_tradeLaunchTradeApproveSemanticLa.zh: 先授权 USD1，当前不可执行

launch_tradeLaunchTradeBalance.en: Includes round fee {launchMissingFigure}, USD1 balance {balance}, allowance {allowance}
launch_tradeLaunchTradeBalance.zh: 包含本轮手续费 {launchMissingFigure}，USD1 余额 {balance}，授权额度 {allowance}

launch_tradeLaunchTradeBuyOnlyBody.en: There's no sell in the bonding pool stage. After graduation and external liquidity, trading moves to Market.
launch_tradeLaunchTradeBuyOnlyBody.zh: 内盘阶段没有卖出接口。毕业并建立外部流动性之后，交易才会转到行情模块。

launch_tradeLaunchTradeCapabilityUnavail.en: Bonding pool purchases aren't available right now

launch_tradeLaunchTradeNoRoundMessage.en: Round config isn't confirmed yet, so there's no price, eligibility or allowance to show.
launch_tradeLaunchTradeNoRoundMessage.zh: 轮次配置尚未确认，因此没有价格、资格或额度可以展示。

launch_tradeLaunchTradeRefusalTitle2.zh: 认购入口当前不可执行

launch_tradeNull.en: On-chain status hasn't loaded yet. This page builds no transaction.
launch_tradeNull.zh: 还没有读到链上状态，本页不构造任何交易。

launch_tradePolling.en: Waiting for the approval to land

launch_tradeReading.en: Loading the USD1 allowance. You can't buy until it loads.
launch_tradeReading.zh: 正在读取 USD1 授权额度，读到之前不能购买。

launch_tradeS.en: {round}Tx {launchShortHex}. Broadcast doesn't mean it was filled; the on-chain index decides, and it will appear in "My participation".
launch_tradeS.zh: {round}交易 {launchShortHex}。广播不代表已成交，结果以链上索引为准，会出现在「我的参与记录」。

launch_tradeS2.en: {chainFailureReason}You can't buy until the allowance loads.
launch_tradeS2.zh: {chainFailureReason}授权额度读到之前不能购买。

launch_tradeSemanticLabel.en: Raise progress can't be loaded right now

launch_tradeSufficient.en: Ready to submit. The status after submitting decides the result.
launch_tradeSufficient.zh: 可以提交，结果以提交后的状态为准。

launch_tradeSwitch.en: Current on-chain status: {launchStateProjection}. You can only buy while the sale is in progress and not paused.
launch_tradeSwitch.zh: 当前链上状态：{launchStateProjection}。只有销售进行中且未暂停时才能认购。

launch_tradeSwitch2.en: No payment wallet yet. Choose one in Wallet first.
launch_tradeSwitch2.zh: 还没有可用的支付钱包，请先在钱包中选择一个。

launch_tradeSwitch3.zh: 请先选择要参与的轮次。

launch_tradeSwitch4.en: Round {roundIndex} hasn't started. You can buy once it opens at {launchTimestampLabel}.
launch_tradeSwitch4.zh: Round {roundIndex} 尚未开始，{launchTimestampLabel} 开放后才能认购。

launch_tradeSwitch5.en: Round {roundIndex} ended at {launchTimestampLabel}. Choose a round in progress.
launch_tradeSwitch5.zh: Round {roundIndex} 已于 {launchTimestampLabel} 结束，请选择进行中的轮次。

launch_tradeSwitch6.en: Enter a valid amount to pay (up to 18 decimals).
launch_tradeSwitch6.zh: 请输入一个有效的支付数量（最多 18 位小数）。

launch_tradeSwitch8.en: Couldn't load this wallet's USD1 allowance on the Launch chain. This page doesn't guess the allowance, so you can't buy yet.
launch_tradeSwitch8.zh: 没有读到这个钱包在 Launch 链上的 USD1 授权额度。本页不猜测授权额度，因此暂不能购买。

launch_tradeUnread.en: Approval status not loaded. This page doesn't guess the allowance, so you can't buy yet.
launch_tradeUnread.zh: 授权状态未读取，本页不猜测授权额度，因此暂不能购买。

launch_widgetsAdd4.en: Platform-verifiable time {launchMissingFigure} (not provided by the operator)
launch_widgetsAdd4.zh: 平台可核验时间 {launchMissingFigure}（操作员未提供）

launch_widgetsAdd6.en: No materials to check for this status
launch_widgetsAdd6.zh: 这一状态没有可查材料

launch_widgetsBuild3.en: The cap applies only in the bonding pool stage and is enforced by the contract. This page writes no fixed ratio or amount; the confirmed config of this launch applies.
launch_widgetsBuild3.zh: 上限只在内盘阶段生效，由合约执行；本页不写入任何固定比例或数量，数值以这次发射被确认的配置为准。

launch_widgetsBuild5.en: The contract enforces the cap on every purchase. This is the contract's reading at the snapshot block, not a fixed ratio or amount LOOP wrote.
launch_widgetsBuild5.zh: 上限由合约在每次认购时执行；这里是合约在快照区块的读数，不是 LOOP 写下的固定比例或数量。

launch_widgetsLabel11.en: Bonding pool ended, soft cap not reached

launch_widgetsLabel8.zh: 内盘已结束，等待最终化

launch_widgetsLaunchChainRowSemanticLabe.en: Launch runs on {loopTestnetBadgeLabel}, {loopLaunchTestnetChainId}; mainnet features are unaffected
launch_widgetsLaunchChainRowSemanticLabe.zh: Launch 运行在 {loopTestnetBadgeLabel}，{loopLaunchTestnetChainId}，主网功能不受影响

launch_widgetsLaunchChainRowSubtitle.en: {loopLaunchTestnetChainId}, Launch chain; wallet balances, market, swap and approvals stay on mainnet
launch_widgetsLaunchChainRowSubtitle.zh: {loopLaunchTestnetChainId}，Launch 链；钱包余额、行情、兑换与授权仍在主网

launch_widgetsMessage.en: This feature isn't available right now

launch_widgetsUnavailable.en: On-chain info can't be loaded right now, so this page shows no contract address, total supply, tax rate or cap.
launch_widgetsUnavailable.zh: 链上信息暂时读不到，因此这一页不显示合约地址、总量、税率或上限。
